name: One&Only Aesthesis
positioning: Beach resort in the coastal neighbourhood of Glyfada, in southern Athens, designed to recall the 1960s heyday of the Athenian Riviera
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort within a 30-minute drive of central Athens
Guests who want a bungalow with its own private pool and outdoor space

facts.text: The resort is in the coastal neighbourhood of Glyfada, in southern Athens.
The resort recalls the 1960s heyday of the Athenian Riviera.
Architectural firms AUDO, A6Architects and K-Studio, with interior design studio Muza Lab, created the resort.
The resort offers transfers in luxury vehicles from Athens International Airport, Piraeus Port and central Athens, each a 30-minute drive away.
The resort is pet-friendly and caters to dogs.
The boat trip from the sister resort on Kea Island takes 45 minutes.
Winters on the Athenian Riviera are mild, and sea swimming is still possible in early to mid October.
Bungalows are dotted around the grounds; some are right on the sea, others surrounded by rosemary, bougainvillea and olive trees.
Connected to the spa are a Technogym fitness centre, a yoga pavilion and an outdoor lap pool.
Every guest has two dedicated hosts, on call around the clock via WhatsApp.
At Ora restaurant most dishes are wood-fired or cooked on the parilla grill.
The resort has padel and tennis courts and non-motorized watersports, including stand-up paddle board and windsurfing lessons.

highlights.text: Bungalow outdoor areas have a private pool, loungers, an outdoor shower and a fireplace.
The design stays true to the essence of the Asteria beach club from the 1950s, which in the 1950s and '60s was a playground for socialites and starlets.
The spa is a Guerlain spa, with treatments featuring Guerlain's signature scents and a Glamour Studio for simultaneous hair, make-up and nail rituals.
A protected forest within the resort's boundaries remains untouched.
Private museum tours, sandal-making workshops and boat trips to the nearby islands of Aegina and Kea can be arranged.

considerations.text: The resort is separated from Glyfada's shops and restaurants by six-lane Poseidonos Avenue, which has heavy traffic.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
